title: Plugins: who can install a Copilot plugin, and how do you block one?
summary: The documented installation, access, blocking and automation controls are supported, including the updated Cowork sharing guidance. Minor corrections should complete two navigation paths and qualify audit coverage for government tenants.

claims.claim: Publisher-category access is configured in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access > installation settings.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **Settings** > **Agent and plugin access**. ... Under the installation settings, choose which publisher categories users can access ... Select a category
claims.fix: Extend the front-matter and rendered path to 'Agents > Settings > Agent and plugin access > installation settings > publisher category'; the documented final selection is Microsoft, your organization or certified external publishers.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors sets publisher access using an applyOnce baseline with microsoft.agent.allowedagenttypes.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... applies a desired-state baseline once in `applyOnce` mode.

claims.claim: Tenant user access to agents and plugins is configured in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Settings > User access.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **Settings** > **User access** to manage your organization's agents and plugins.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors sets all-users or no-users access using an applyOnce baseline with microsoft.agent.useraccess.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... An active `applyOnce` monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: Individual plugin availability is configured in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin > Users.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **Tools** > **Plugins**. ... Select the plugin that you want to manage. ... Open **Users**, and then choose one of the following availability options:
claims.fix: Extend the front-matter and rendered path to 'Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin > Users > availability option'; the documented final choices are All users, No users or Specific users and groups.

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} changes plugin availability through availableTo and allowedUsersAndGroups.
claims.quote: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} ... `allowedUsersAndGroups` ... Users/groups for whom the package is available. ... `availableTo` ... Required if updating `allowedUsersAndGroups`.

claims.claim: Administrator installation is initiated in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > plugin > Install.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **Tools**. ... From the list, select the plugin or skill that you want to install, and then select **Install**.

claims.claim: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id} changes deployment through deployedTo and acquireUsersAndGroups.
claims.quote: `acquireUsersAndGroups` ... Users/groups for whom the package is deployed. ... `deployedTo` ... Enum value indicating the deployment scope of the package. Required if updating `acquireUsersAndGroups`.

claims.claim: A plugin is blocked in Microsoft 365 admin center at Agents > Tools > Plugins > plugin > Block.
claims.quote: Select **Agents** > **Tools** > **Plugins**. ... From the list, select the plugin or skill that you want to block. ... Select **Block**, and then select **Block** again to confirm.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a package to prevent usage.
claims.quote: Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.claim: The Word desktop legal control is reached in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center through Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Legal Skills in M365 Copilot in Word.
claims.quote: Access to the plugin can be governed via the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. ... creating a policy configuration in the Policy Management tool. The policy name is "Legal Skills in M365 Copilot in Word".
